subject: Renewal + Capacity uplift — exhibit consolidation & order form redlines
messages:
From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@seraphicsys.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal conversation — draft order form and term question

Karthik / Laura,

Thanks for walking us through the usage reports yesterday. We ran the numbers and want to move forward with a renewal + capacity uplift. A couple of items we need your help with before we sign:

- Move the term from 12 months to 18 months (pricing on p2) — we expect sustained higher usage across Q1–Q2.
- Add 300k token seat-equivalent for conversational API (exhibit E) with burst capacity.
- We have a legal ask to consolidate the order form language into a single exhibit rather than separate addenda — reduces our procurement cycles.

I've attached our internal proposed order form (Proposed_OrderForm_Accel_v2.docx) with redline suggestions and sent a DocuSign intent link to speed signature once redlines are accepted. Can your legal ops team take a look and share a marked-up MSA/Exhibit that aligns with the consolidated approach?

Priya (cc'd) will own procurement on our side — loop her in on any CLA/insurance adjustments.

Appreciate a quick read — we are targeting an execution window by 11/24.

Thanks,
Alex Moore
Head of Platform Partnerships
Seraphic Systems

-----
Attachment: Proposed_OrderForm_Accel_v2.docx (docx)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@seraphicsys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — draft order form and term question

Alex — thanks for the note and the clear asks. We're excited to keep Seraphic on the platform and support the 18‑month term + uplift. Quick plan from our side:

1) Legal ops (Laura) will take your proposed order form and produce a consolidated Exhibit E that folds the addenda into a single order bundle.
2) Ben (CC) will confirm pricing math for the 18‑month term and the 300k token uplift — we may be able to offer a modest term-based discount if locked to 18 months.
3) I will surface any material SLA/insurance changes; please confirm if you need SOC 2 evidence beyond the standard pack.

Laura — can you pick this up and aim for a marked MSA with tracked changes by EOD 11/18? Ben, can you validate pricing / term discount options and share an updated order form?

Karthik
Director, Platform Sales
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@seraphicsys.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-17T14:28:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal conversation — draft order form and term question

Alex / Karthik — picking this up. I reviewed your proposed order form and the consolidation approach makes sense operationally, but there are three legal points we need to align on before folding everything into Exhibit E:

1) Indemnity carveouts — your draft expands the customer indemnities into a single clause. We propose keeping the standard Redwood mutual indemnities but adding a limited IP carveout for customer-supplied models.
2) Data retention and deletion — for the 18‑month term, we need explicit language on retention windows for cached KV prefixes and logs if you require extended retention beyond 90 days.
3) Billing proration for mid-term seat/usage changes — propose a short schedule (Annex A) for mid-term capacity adjustments to avoid later disputes.

I've attached an initial marked-up PDF of the MSA/Exhibit with comments (MSA-with-exhibitE-trackchanges.pdf). Please review and let me know if Alex/Priya can accept these points; if so, I will produce a clean consolidated Exhibit E and updated order form for signature.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Legal Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

-----
Attachment: MSA-with-exhibitE-trackchanges.pdf (pdf)
From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@seraphicsys.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@seraphicsys.com>
Date: 2025-11-18T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — draft order form and term question

Laura — thanks, that layout is helpful. Quick responses: 

1) IP carveout — acceptable if narrowly scoped to customer-prompted models and documented in Annex B.
2) Retention — Seraphic is okay with a standard 90‑day KV/log retention for production traffic, but we need a 12‑month retention option for a small subset (audit logs). Can we add a data retention checkbox in Exhibit E that flags the 12‑month audit retention and associated fee schedule?
3) Billing proration — agreed, Annex A for mid-term adjustments works for us; we will accept Redwood's calculation method provided it's transparent.

If you can produce a consolidated Exhibit E with the proposed Annexes (A for proration, B for IP carveouts, C for retention checkbox & fee), we will get Procurement to expedite review. Looking forward to the updated doc.

Best,
Alex
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@seraphicsys.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-19T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — draft order form and term question

Alex — pricing update attached inline and in the updated order form (see link). Summary:

- Baseline renewal (12mo -> 18mo) — list price shows a 7% term discount applied across committed tokens; effective blended rate lowers unit cost by ~6.4% over 18 months.
- 300k token uplift — priced as an add-on line item with prorated ramp (month 1 billing 30% of uplift, month 2 60%, month 3 full).
- 12‑month audit retention checkbox — optional fee $2,500/month (covers storage + extended log retention).

I'll attach a clean order form that includes Annex A (proration formula), Annex B (IP carveout language suggested by Laura), and Annex C (retention checkbox with fee schedule). Let me know if Proc needs a redline view or if this clean copy is sufficient for signature.

Ben Carter
Principal, Deals 
Redwood Inference

-----
Attachment: OrderForm_RWI-9231_v3.docx (docx)
From: Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@seraphicsys.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-20T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — draft order form and term question

Team — this looks good and aligns with Procurement priorities. Two small asks before we return for signature: 

1) Can you add a one‑paragraph insurance acknowledgement specific to our EULA‑driven data residency requirement (we host EU customers too)? We can sign off if that's a short clause.
2) Please ensure the DocuSign packet includes both the consolidated Exhibit E and the updated OrderForm_RWI-9231_v3.docx as separate attachments so our legal team can confirm clause-by-clause.

If you can get those two items in the packet today, we will queue for signature and target execution by 11/24 as Alex noted.

Thanks — Priya on behalf of Seraphic Procurement
